banglaExplanation: Self-assessment guide হলো competency areas-এর একটা তালিকা — trainee নিজেই টিক দিয়ে বলে কোনটা পারে, কোনটা পারে না।
Session শুরুর আগেই এটা দিন, তাহলে trainee-র level of competency বোঝা যায়।
এতে trainer আর trainee দুজনেই জানে training-এর best starting point কোথায়।
Guide বানানো হয় unit of competency-র performance criteria থেকে; প্রতিটি লাইনে "Can you..." আর Yes/No।

example.bn: Welding কোর্সের আগে প্রত্যেক trainee প্রতিটি performance criteria-র পাশে Yes বা No টিক দেয়।
example.en: Before a welding course, Chattogram trainees tick Yes or No for each criterion.

extra.note_bn: প্রতিটি লাইন unit-এর একটি performance criteria; trainee Yes বা No টিক দেয়। No-গুলোই তার training need।
rows: 1.1 Observe Safe work practices and personal protective equipment (PPE) as required for the work performed.
2.1 Identify weld requirements, specifications from work place drawing.
3.2 Mark materials (plate) and cut as per dimension of specification, drawing.
3.3 Prepare edges prepared as per job specification to meet industry requirements.
3.4 Assemble materials and align with required gap.
3.5 Use weld gauge and or measuring instruments as per workplace/industry requirements.
4.1. Set up Job using a clamp at required position (1G or 2G)
5.1. Set up welding equipment and adjust as per job requirements.
6.1 Perform weld as per specification and standard (WPS).
6.2 Clean welds in accordance with standard operating procedures
6.3. Check weld for quality and any defects are identified and corrective action is taken to standard operating procedures.
